note: The biometric passport's fee is SCR 750; enrolled at an embassy it's SCR 750 and SCR 1,000 postage from Seychelles. A lost passport's penalty (SCR 1,500) is written as replacement routes: SCR 2,250 at home, SCR 3,250 through an embassy with the postage. Validity isn't stated on the Department's pages, a lead.

sources.title: Immigration and Civil Status Department, Seychelles, Applying for a Seychelles Passport
sources.said: Collection may be done 72 hours (3 working days) after enrollment. ... sources.title: Immigration and Civil Status Department, Seychelles, FAQ: Seychelles Bio-Metric Passport
sources.said: The fee of the Bio-Metric passport remains the same at SCR750 per applicant. The payment is made after the application has been submitted and can be paid by card or cash. You may receive your new passport in 72hours after application. ... Please note that if your passport was misplaced a surcharge fee of 1500 is to be paid to the Immigration Department
